sql: SELECT A.COMPANYCODE AS COMPANYCODE, A.BUSINESSUNITCODE AS BUSINESSUNITCODE, A.FINANCIALYEARCODE AS FINANCIALYEARCODE, A.DOCUMENTTEMPLATECODE AS DOCUMENTTEMPLATECODE, A.STATISTICALGROUPCODE AS STATISTICALGROUPCODE, A.CODE AS CODE, B.ASSETCODE AS ASSETCODE, B.ASSETCOUNTERCODE AS ASSETCOUNTERCODE, A.POSTINGDATE AS POSTINGDATE, B.AMOUNTINCC AS AMOUNTINCC, B.AMOUNTINDC AS AMOUNTINDC, A.DOCUMENTCURRENCYCODE as DOCUMENTCURRENCYCODE FROM FINASSETCAPITALIZATION B JOIN FINDOCUMENT A ON ( A.COMPANYCODE = B.FFINDOCUMENTCOMPANYCODE AND A.BUSINESSUNITCODE = B.FFINDOCUMENTBUSINESSUNITCODE AND A.FINANCIALYEARCODE = B.FFINDOCUMENTFINANCIALYEARCODE AND A.DOCUMENTTEMPLATECODE = B.FFINDOCDOCUMENTTEMPLATECODE AND A.STATISTICALGROUPCODE = B.FFINDOCSTATISTICALGROUPCODE AND A.CODE = B.FFINDOCUMENTCODE )

MAINASSETASSETUGENGRPTYPECODE = D. ASSETUSERGENERICGROUPTYPECODE AND C.MainAssetAssetCode = D.AssetCode AND C.MAINASSETCODE = D.CODE) LEFT OUTER JOIN UserGenericGroup E ON (C.CompanyCode = E.USERGENGROUPTYPECOMPANYCODE AND C.AGUSERGENERICGROUPTYPECODE = E.USERGENERICGROUPTYPECODE AND C.AGCode = E.Code ) LEFT OUTER JOIN Counter F ON (C.CompanyCode = F.CompanyCode AND C.CounterCode = F.CODE)

name: VIEWABSTILEDESCRIPTION
sql: WITH FULLABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS AS (SELECT DISTINCT FATHERID, CODE AS LANGUAGECODE FROM ABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS CROSS JOIN ABSAVAILABLELANGUAGE), FULLABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS AS (SELECT DISTINCT FATHERID, CODE AS LANGUAGECODE FROM ABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS CROSS JOIN ABSAVAILABLELANGUAGE) SELECT ABSUNIQUEID, RTYPE, STYPE, AT, TT, LABELKEY, CASE WHEN (RTYPE = 1 ) THEN FULLABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS.LANGUAGECODE WHEN (RTYPE = 2 ) THEN FULLABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS.LANGUAGECODE END LANGCODE, CASE WHEN (RTYPE = 1 AND STYPE = 1) THEN ABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS.DESCRIPTION WHEN (RTYPE = 1 AND STYPE = 2) THEN ABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS.TILETEXT WHEN (RTYPE = 2 AND STYPE = 1) THEN ABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS.DESCRIPTION END DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN (RTYPE = 1 ) THEN TO_CHAR(AT) WHEN (RTYPE = 2 ) THEN TT END ORIGINCODE FROM ( select ABSUNIQUEID, 1 as RTYPE, 1 as STYPE, code as AT, ' ' as TT, ABSAVAILABLETILES.DESCRIPTION AS LABELKEY, TO_CHAR(CODE) AS ORIGINCODE from ABSAVAILABLETILES WHERE DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL union all select ABSUNIQUEID, 1 as RTYPE, 2 as STYPE, code as AT, ' ' as TT, ABSAVAILABLETILES.TILETEXT AS LABELKEY, TO_CHAR(CODE) AS ORIGINCODE from ABSAVAILABLETILES WHERE tiletext IS NOT NULL union all select ABSUNIQUEID, 2 as RTYPE, 1 as STYPE, 0 AS AT, code as TT, ABSTILETEMPLATE.DESCRIPTION AS LABELKEY, CODE AS ORIGINCODE from ABSTILETEMPLATE WHERE DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL) left outer join FULLABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS on ABSUNIQUEID = FULLABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS.FATHERID left outer join ABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS on ABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS.FATHERID = FULLABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS.FATHERID AND ABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS.LANGUAGECODE = FULLABSAVAILABLETILESDESCRIPTIONS.LANGUAGECODE left outer join FULLABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS on ABSUNIQUEID = FULLABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS.FATHERID left outer join ABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS on ABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS.FATHERID = FULLABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS.FATHERID AND ABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS.LANGUAGECODE = FULLABSTILETEMPLATEDESCRIPTIONS.LANGUAGECODE

SALESDOCUMENTLINE.NETVALUE / SALESDOCUMENTLINE.BASEPRIMARYQUANTITY ) * -1 WHEN (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.ONLYBYAMOUNT = 0 AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PRICESIGN <> '2 ' AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PROGRESSSTATUS <> '2' ) DECIMAL(18,5))) END SNETVALUEINCMPCURRENCY, CASE WHEN (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PRICESIGN = '2 ') THEN (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.TAXABLEINCOMEVALUE * -1 / CAST((CASE WHEN COALESCE(SALESDOCUMENTLINE.ENTRYEXCHANGERATE,0.0) <> 0.0 THEN SALESDOCUMENTLINE.ENTRYEXCHANGERATE ELSE 1.0 END) AS DECIMAL(18,5))) ELSE (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.TAXABLEINCOMEVALUE / CAST((CASE WHEN INT)+0.5*CAST(SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PROGRESSSTATUS AS INT)+1) * (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PRICE - SALESDOCUMENTLINE.USEDAMOUNT)) / CAST((CASE WHEN COALESCE(SALESDOCUMENTLINE.ENTRYEXCHANGERATE,0.0) <> 0.0 THEN SALESDOCUMENTLINE.DLVSALORDERLINESALESORDERCODE = SALESORDER.CODE) LEFT JOIN SALESORDERDELIVERY ON (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.SALESDOCUMENTCOMPANYCODE = SALESORDERDELIVERY.SALORDLINESALORDERCOMPANYCODE AND AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.DLVSALESORDERLINEORDERLINE = SALESORDERDELIVERY.SALESORDERLINEORDERLINE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.DLVSALESORDERLINEORDERSUBLINE = SALESORDERDELIVERY.SALESORDERLINEORDERSUBLINE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.DLVSALORDLINECMPORDERLINE = SALESORDERDELIVERY.SALORDLINECOMPONENTORDERLINE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.DELIVERYDELIVERYLINE = SALESORDERDELIVERY.DELIVERYLINE) LEFT JOIN SALESRELEASELINE ON (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.SALESDOCUMENTCOMPANYCODE = SALESRELEASELINE.COMPANYCODE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PREVIOUSCODE = SALESRELEASELINE.CODE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PREVIOUSORDERLINE = SALESRELEASELINE.LINE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PREVIOUSORDERSUBLINE = SALESRELEASELINE.SUBLINE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PREVIOUSCOMPONENTORDERLINE = SALESRELEASELINE.COMPONENTRELEASELINE) LEFT JOIN SALESDOCUMENT SALDOCPREV ON (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.SALESDOCUMENTCOMPANYCODE = SALDOCPREV.COMPANYCODE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PREVIOUSCOUNTERCODE = SALDOCPREV.PROVISIONALCOUNTERCODE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PREVIOUSCODE = SALDOCPREV.PROVISIONALCODE ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT STOCKTRANSACTION.COMPANYCODE, STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERCOUNTERCODE, STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERCODE, STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERLINE, STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERSUBLINE, STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERCOMPONENTLINE, MAX(STOCKTRANSACTION.TRANSACTIONDATE) TRANSACTIONDATE FROM STOCKTRANSACTION WHERE STOCKTRANSACTION.STOCKTRANSACTIONTYPE = '7' GROUP BY STOCKTRANSACTION.COMPANYCODE, STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERCOUNTERCODE, STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERCODE, STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERLINE, STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERSUBLINE, STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERCOMPONENTLINE ) STOCKTRANSACTION ON (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.SALESDOCUMENTCOMPANYCODE = STOCKTRANSACTION.COMPANYCODE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.SALDOCPROVISIONALCOUNTERCODE = STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERCOUNTERCODE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.SALESDOCUMENTPROVISIONALCODE = STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERCODE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.ORDERLINE = STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERLINE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.ORDERSUBLINE = STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERSUBLINE AND SALESDOCUMENTLINE.COMPONENTORDERLINE = STOCKTRANSACTION.ORDERCOMPONENTLINE) LEFT JOIN SELLINGITEM ON SALESDOCUMENTLINE.SELLINGITEMIDENTIFIER = SELLINGITEM.IDENTIFIER LEFT JOIN FULLITEMKEYDECODER ON SALESDOCUMENTLINE.FULLITEMIDENTIFIER = FULLITEMKEYDECODER.IDENTIFIER WHERE SALESDOCUMENTLINE.DOCUMENTTYPETYPE = '05' OR (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.DOCUMENTTYPETYPE = '08' AND (SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PREVIOUSDOCUMENTTYPETYPE IS NULL OR SALESDOCUMENTLINE.PREVIOUSDOCUMENTTYPETYPE<> '05'))

ALLOCATION ON (SALESORDERDELIVERY.SALORDLINESALORDERCOMPANYCODE = ALLOCATION.COMPANYCODE AND SALESORDERDELIVERY.SALORDLINESALORDERCOUNTERCODE = ALLOCATION.COUNTERCODE AND COALESCE(PRODUCTIONDEMAND.ENTEREDUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY,0.0) - COALESCE(PRODUCTIONDEMANDLINK.USERPRIMARYQUANTITY,0.0))RSDUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY, PRODUCTIONDEMAND.BASEPRIMARYUOMCODE RSDBASEPRIMARYUOMCODE, (PRODUCTIONDEMAND.FINALBASEPRIMARYQUANTITY - COALESCE(PRODUCTIONDEMAND.ENTEREDBASEPRIMARYQUANTITY,0.0) - COALESCE(PRODUCTIONDEMANDLINK.BASEPRIMARYQUANTITY,0.0)) RSDBASEPRIMARYQUANTITY, PRODUCTIONDEMAND.USERSECONDARYUOMCODE RSDUSERSECONDARYUOMCODE, (PRODUCTIONDEMAND.FINALUSERSECONDARYQUANTITY - COALESCE(PRODUCTIONDEMAND.ENTEREDUSERSECONDARYQUANTITY,0.0) - COALESCE(PRODUCTIONDEMANDLINK.USERSECONDARYQUANTITY,0.0)) RSDUSERSECONDARYQUANTITY, PRODUCTIONDEMAND.BASESECONDARYUOMCODE RSDBASESECONDARYUOMCODE, (PRODUCTIONDEMAND.FINALBASESECONDARYQUANTITY - COALESCE(PRODUCTIONDEMAND.ENTEREDBASESECONDARYQUANTITY,0.0) - COALESCE(PRODUCTIONDEMANDLINK.BASESECONDARYQUANTITY,0.0)) RSDBASESECONDARYQUANTITY, PRODUCTIONDEMAND.USERPACKAGINGUOMCODE RSDUSERPACKAGINGUOMCODE, (PRODUCTIONDEMAND.FINALUSERPACKAGINGQUANTITY - COALESCE(PRODUCTIONDEMAND.ENTEREDUSERPACKAGINGQUANTITY,0.0) - COALESCE(PRODUCTIONDEMANDLINK.USERPACKAGINGQUANTITY,0.0)) RSDUSERPACKAGINGQUANTITY, PRODUCTIONDEMAND.FINALPLANNEDDATE FINALPLANNEDDATE, PRODUCTIONDEMAND.FULLITEMIDENTIFIER FULLITEMIDENTIFIER FROM PRODUCTIONDEMAND LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCTIONDEMANDTEMPLATE ON PRODUCTIONDEMANDTEMPLATE.COMPANYCODE = PRODUCTIONDEMAND.COMPANYCODE AND PRODUCTIONDEMANDTEMPLATE.CODE = PRODUCTIONDEMAND.TEMPLATECODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCTIONDEMANDCOMPANYCODE, PRODUCTIONDEMANDCOUNTERCODE, PRODUCTIONDEMANDCODE, SUM(USERPRIMARYQUANTITY) - SUM(COALESCE(USEDUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY,0.0)) USERPRIMARYQUANTITY, SUM(BASEPRIMARYQUANTITY) - SUM(COALESCE(USEDBASEPRIMARYQUANTITY,0.0)) BASEPRIMARYQUANTITY, SUM(USERSECONDARYQUANTITY) - SUM(COALESCE(USEDUSERSECONDARYQUANTITY,0.0)) USERSECONDARYQUANTITY, SUM(BASESECONDARYQUANTITY) - SUM(COALESCE(USEDBASESECONDARYQUANTITY,0.0)) BASESECONDARYQUANTITY, SUM(USERPACKAGINGQUANTITY) - SUM(COALESCE(USEDUSERPACKAGINGQUANTITY,0.0)) USERPACKAGINGQUANTITY FROM PRODUCTIONDEMANDLINK GROUP BY PRODUCTIONDEMANDCOMPANYCODE, PRODUCTIONDEMANDCOUNTERCODE, PRODUCTIONDEMANDCODE ) PRODUCTIONDEMANDLINK ON PRODUCTIONDEMANDLINK.PRODUCTIONDEMANDCOMPANYCODE = PRODUCTIONDEMAND.COMPANYCODE AND PRODUCTIONDEMANDLINK.PRODUCTIONDEMANDCOUNTERCODE = PRODUCTIONDEMAND.COUNTERCODE AND PRODUCTIONDEMANDLINK.PRODUCTIONDEMANDCODE = PRODUCTIONDEMAND.CODE WHERE PRODUCTIONDEMAND.PROGRESSSTATUS <> '6' AND PRODUCTIONDEMAND.DESTINATIONORDER = '0' and PRODUCTIONDEMANDTEMPLATE.PLANNINGBYORDERMULTILINKS = 1 )

sql: ( SELECT PRIO.COMPANYCODE, PRIO.ORGANIZER, PRIO.OPERATIONTYPE, PRIO.PRODUCTIONORDERCODE, SUM(PRIO.ENTEREDQTY) ENTEREDQTY, MIN(PO.PROGRESSSTATUS) AS PROGRESSSTATUS, MIN((CASE WHEN MINSTATUS = MAXSTATUS THEN MINSTATUS WHEN MAXSTATUS = '2' THEN '1' WHEN MAXSTATUS = '4' THEN '3' ELSE MAXSTATUS END)) STATUSORGANIZERHEADER FROM ( SELECT IDLANDALL.COMPANYCODE, IDLANDALL.ORGANIZER, MIN(CASE WHEN IDLANDALL.PROGRESSSTATUS IS NULL THEN '0' WHEN IDLANDALL.PROGRESSSTATUS = '0' AND IDLANDALL.ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY IS NULL THEN '0' WHEN IDLANDALL.PROGRESSSTATUS = '0' AND IDLANDALL.ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY < IDLANDALL.IDLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY THEN '1' WHEN IDLANDALL.PROGRESSSTATUS = '0' AND IDLANDALL.ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY >= IDLANDALL.IDLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY THEN '2' WHEN IDLANDALL.PROGRESSSTATUS = '1' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END) MINSTATUS, MAX(CASE WHEN IDLANDALL.PROGRESSSTATUS IS NULL THEN '0' WHEN IDLANDALL.PROGRESSSTATUS = '0' AND IDLANDALL.ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY IS NULL THEN '0' WHEN IDLANDALL.PROGRESSSTATUS = '0' AND IDLANDALL.ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY < IDLANDALL.IDLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY THEN '1' WHEN IDLANDALL.PROGRESSSTATUS = '0' AND IDLANDALL.ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY >= IDLANDALL.IDLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY THEN '2' WHEN IDLANDALL.PROGRESSSTATUS = '1' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END) MAXSTATUS FROM (SELECT ID.COMPANYCODE, ID.PROVISIONALCOUNTERCODE COUNTERCODE, ID.PROVISIONALCODE ORDERCODE, MIN(ID.ORGANIZER) ORGANIZER, IDL.ORDERLINE, IDL.ORDERSUBLINE, MIN(IDL.PROGRESSSTATUS) PROGRESSSTATUS, MIN(IDL.USERPRIMARYQUANTITY) IDLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY, SUM(A.USERPRIMARYQUANTITY) ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY FROM INTERNALDOCUMENT ID JOIN INTERNALDOCUMENTLINE IDL ON IDL.INTERNALDOCUMENTCOMPANYCODE = ID.COMPANYCODE AND IDL.INTDOCPROVISIONALCOUNTERCODE = ID.PROVISIONALCOUNTERCODE AND IDL.INTDOCUMENTPROVISIONALCODE = ID.PROVISIONALCODE LEFT JOIN ALLOCATION A ON A.COMPANYCODE = IDL.INTERNALDOCUMENTCOMPANYCODE AND A.COUNTERCODE = IDL.INTDOCPROVISIONALCOUNTERCODE AND A.ORDERCODE = IDL.INTDOCUMENTPROVISIONALCODE AND A.ORDERLINE = IDL.ORDERLINE AND A.ORDERSUBLINENUMBER = IDL.ORDERSUBLINE AND A.DETAILTYPE = '1' AND A.ORIGINTYPE = '1' WHERE ID.ORGANIZER IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRODRESERVATIONISSUEORGANIZER PRIO WHERE PRIO.COMPANYCODE = ID.COMPANYCODE AND PRIO.ORGANIZER = ID.ORGANIZER AND PRIO.OPERATIONTYPE = '1') GROUP BY ID.COMPANYCODE, ID.PROVISIONALCOUNTERCODE, ID.PROVISIONALCODE, ID.ORGANIZER, IDL.ORDERLINE, IDL.ORDERSUBLINE) IDLANDALL GROUP BY IDLANDALL.COMPANYCODE, IDLANDALL.ORGANIZER UNION ALL SELECT A.COMPANYCODE, A.ORGANIZER, MIN(CASE WHEN A.PROGRESSSTATUS = '0' THEN '2' WHEN A.PROGRESSSTATUS = '1' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END) MINSTATUS, MAX(CASE WHEN A.PROGRESSSTATUS = '0' THEN '2' WHEN A.PROGRESSSTATUS = '1' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END) MAXSTATUS FROM ALLOCATION A WHERE A.ORGANIZER IS NOT NULL AND A.DETAILTYPE = '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRODRESERVATIONISSUEORGANIZER PRIO WHERE PRIO.COMPANYCODE = A.COMPANYCODE AND PRIO.ORGANIZER = A.ORGANIZER AND PRIO.OPERATIONTYPE = '2') GROUP BY A.COMPANYCODE, A.ORGANIZER UNION ALL SELECT PRIO.COMPANYCODE, PRIO.ORGANIZER, MIN(CASE WHEN STUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY >= TOBEISSUEDQTY THEN '4' WHEN STUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY > 0 THEN '3' WHEN ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY >= TOBEISSUEDQTY THEN '2' WHEN ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) MINSTATUS, MAX(CASE WHEN STUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY >= TOBEISSUEDQTY THEN '4' WHEN STUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY > 0 THEN '3' WHEN ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY >= TOBEISSUEDQTY THEN '2' WHEN ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) MAXSTATUS FROM (SELECT PRIO.COMPANYCODE, PRIO.ORGANIZER, PRIO.COUNTERCODE, PRIO.ORDERCODE, PRIO.ORDERLINE, SUM(STUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY) STUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY, SUM(ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY) ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY, SUM(TOBEISSUEDQTY) TOBEISSUEDQTY FROM (SELECT A.COMPANYCODE, A.ORGANIZER, A.COUNTERCODE, A.ORDERCODE, A.ORDERLINE, 0.0 STUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY, USERPRIMARYQUANTITY ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY, 0.0 TOBEISSUEDQTY FROM ALLOCATION A WHERE A.ORGANIZER IS NOT NULL AND A.DETAILTYPE = '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRODRESERVATIONISSUEORGANIZER PRIO WHERE PRIO.COMPANYCODE = A.COMPANYCODE AND PRIO.ORGANIZER = A.ORGANIZER AND PRIO.OPERATIONTYPE = '3') UNION ALL SELECT PRO.COMPANYCODE, PRO.ORGANIZER, PRO.PRORESERVATIONORDCOUNTERCODE COUNTERCODE, PRO.PRODUCTIONRESERVATIONORDERCODE ORDERCODE, PRO.PRORESERVATIONRESERVATIONLINE ORDERLINE, 0.0 STUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY, 0.0 ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY, TOBEISSUEDQTY FROM PRODRESERVATIONORGANIZER PRO UNION ALL SELECT PRSO.COMPANYCODE, PRSO.ORGANIZER, PRSO.RESERVATIONORDERCOUNTERCODE COUNTERCODE, PRSO.RESERVATIONORDERCODE ORDERCODE, PRSO.RESERVATIONORDERLINE ORDERLINE, ST.USERPRIMARYQUANTITY STUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY, 0.0 ALLUSERPRIMARYQUANTITY, 0.0 TOBEISSUEDQTY FROM PRODRESERVATIONSTOCKORGANIZER PRSO JOIN STOCKTRANSACTION ST ON ST.COMPANYCODE = PRSO.COMPANYCODE AND ST.TRANSACTIONNUMBER = PRSO.STOCKTRANSACTIONNUMBER AND ST.TRANSACTIONDETAILNUMBER = PRSO.STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAILNUMBER) PRIO GROUP BY PRIO.COMPANYCODE, PRIO.ORGANIZER, PRIO.COUNTERCODE, PRIO.ORDERCODE, PRIO.ORDERLINE) PRIO GROUP BY PRIO.COMPANYCODE, PRIO.ORGANIZER ) DETAIL JOIN PRODRESERVATIONISSUEORGANIZER PRIO ON PRIO.COMPANYCODE = DETAIL.COMPANYCODE AND PRIO.ORGANIZER = DETAIL.ORGANIZER JOIN PRODUCTIONORDER PO ON PO.COMPANYCODE = PRIO.COMPANYCODE AND PO.CODE = PRIO.PRODUCTIONORDERCODE GROUP BY PRIO.COMPANYCODE, PRIO.ORGANIZER, PRIO.OPERATIONTYPE, PRIO.PRODUCTIONORDERCODE )

= PAC.PROSTEPCOSTPROCOSTCOSTNUMBER AND PSC.STEPNUMBER = PAC.PRODUCTIONSTEPCOSTSTEPNUMBER LEFT JOIN COMPANY ON PAC.PROSTEPCOSTPROCOSTCOMPANYCODE = COMPANY.CODE

sql: ( SELECT PMS.COMPANYCODE, PMS.INSPECTIONDATE, PMS.PLANTCODE, P.LONGDESCRIPTION PLANTDESC, PMS.DEPARTMENTCODE, D.LONGDESCRIPTION DEPARTMENTDESC, PMS.WORKCENTERCODE, W.LONGDESCRIPTION WORKCENTERDESC, PMS.PMBOMCOUNTERCODE PMMACHINECOUNTERCODE, PMS.PMBOMCODE PMMACHINECODE, M.LONGDESCRIPTION MACHINEDESC, PMS.FIELD1 POWER, PMS.FIELD2 STEAM, PMS.FIELD3 PROPANE, PMS.FIELD4 SOFTWATER, PMS.FIELD5 THERMICHEAT, PMS.HALLUSERGENERICGROUPTYPECODE HALLUSERGROUPTYPE, PMS.HALLCODE FROM PMINSPECTIONHEADERSINGLE PMS LEFT JOIN PLANT P ON (PMS.COMPANYCODE = P.COMPANYCODE AND PMS.PLANTCODE = P.CODE) LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON (PMS.COMPANYCODE = D.COMPANYCODE AND PMS.DEPARTMENTCODE = D.CODE) LEFT JOIN WORKCENTER W ON (PMS.COMPANYCODE = W.COMPANYCODE AND PMS.WORKCENTERCODE = W.CODE) LEFT JOIN PMBOM M ON (PMS.COMPANYCODE = M.COMPANYCODE AND PMS.PMBOMCOUNTERCODE = M.COUNTERCODE AND PMS.PMBOMCODE = M.CODE) LEFT JOIN USERGENERICGROUP UG ON (PMS.COMPANYCODE = UG.USERGENGROUPTYPECOMPANYCODE AND PMS.HALLUSERGENERICGROUPTYPECODE = UG.USERGENERICGROUPTYPECODE AND PMS.HALLCODE = UG.CODE) WHERE PMS.UGCODE ='UTY' AND PMS.PROCESSCODECODE = 'U01' )

EXTOPDOCUMENTLINE.EXTOPDOCUMENTPROVCOUNTERCODE AND EXTOPDOCUMENT.PROVISIONALCODE = EXTOPDOCUMENTLINE.EXTOPDOCUMENTPROVISIONALCODE LEFT OUTER JOIN LOGICALWAREHOUSE ON name: VIEWNETWFMPurPrint
sql: ( SELECT A.companycode, A.countercode, A.purchaseOrderCode, A.wfm, /* WFMPROCESSID, A.tText ,*/ ASSIGNEE_ AS ASSIGNEE, END_TIME_ AS ENDTIME FROM ( SELECT purchaseorder.companycode , purchaseorder.countercode, purchaseorder.code AS purchaseOrderCode, wfm , trim(purchaseorder.companycode) CONCAT '|' CONCAT trim (purchaseorder.countercode) CONCAT '|' CONCAT trim(purchaseorder.code) AS tText FROM purchaseorder LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PURCHASEORDERTEMPLATE.COMPANYCODE, PURCHASEORDERTEMPLATE.CHECKORDERCODE , PURCHASEORDERTEMPLATE.CODE AS PURCHASTEMPLATE , CASE WHEN LOCATE('WFM', CHECKORDERCODE) > 0 THEN 'WFM Enabled' ELSE 'WFM Disabled' END AS wfm FROM PURCHASEORDERTEMPLATE) AS TEMPLATE ON purchaseorder.companycode = TEMPLATE.COMPANYCODE AND purchaseorder.TEMPLATECODE = TEMPLATE.PURCHASTEMPLATE) AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT WFMPROCESSID, TRIM(REFERENCEDENTITYPK) AS REFERENCEDENTITYPK FROM WFMLINKEDENTITY AS t WHERE creationdatetime = ( SELECT MAX(creationdatetime) FROM WFMLINKEDENTITY WHERE REFERENCEDENTITYPK = t.REFERENCEDENTITYPK) AND groupfamily = 'WFMPO' AND REFERENCEDENTITY = 'PurchaseOrder') AS AA ON AA.REFERENCEDENTITYPK= A.tText LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ASSIGNEE_, END_TIME_, PROC_INST_ID_ FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST AS t WHERE END_TIME_ = ( SELECT MAX(END_TIME_) FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST WHERE PROC_INST_ID_ = t.PROC_INST_ID_ )) AS B ON WFMPROCESSID = B.PROC_INST_ID_ )

ORDERPARTNER.ORDERBUSINESSPARTNERNUMBERID = BUSINESSPARTNER.NUMBERID LEFT OUTER JOIN ADDRESSGST ON BUSINESSPARTNER.ABSUNIQUEID = ADDRESSGST.UNIQUEID LEFT OUTER JOIN PURCHASEORDER ON MRNHEADER.COMPANYCODE = PURCHASEORDER.COMPANYCODE AND MRNHEADER.PURCHASEORDERCOUNTERCODE = PURCHASEORDER.COUNTERCODE AND MRNHEADER.PURCHASEORDERCODE = PURCHASEORDER.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN MRNDETAIL ON MRNHEADER.COMPANYCODE = MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE AND MRNHEADER.DIVISIONCODE = MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERDIVISIONCODE AND MRNHEADER.MRNPREFIXCODE = MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERMRNPREFIXCODE AND MRNHEADER.CODE = MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ITEMTYPE ON MRNDETAIL.ITEMTYPEAFICOMPANYCODE = ITEMTYPE.COMPANYCODE AND MRNDETAIL.ITEMTYPEAFICODE = ITEMTYPE.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN STOCKTRANSACTION ON MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE = STOCKTRANSACTION.COMPANYCODE AND MRNDETAIL.TRANSACTIONNUMBER = STOCKTRANSACTION.TRANSACTIONNUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN STOCKTRANSACTIONTEMPLATE ON STOCKTRANSACTION.TEMPLATECOMPANYCODE = STOCKTRANSACTIONTEMPLATE.COMPANYCODE AND STOCKTRANSACTION.TEMPLATECODE = STOCKTRANSACTIONTEMPLATE.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN STOCKTYPE ON STOCKTRANSACTIONTEMPLATE.STOCKTYPECODE = STOCKTYPE.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN EXTOPLINE ON MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE = EXTOPLINE.COMPANYCODE AND MRNDETAIL.EXTOPCOUNTERCODE = EXTOPLINE.COUNTERCODE AND MRNDETAIL.EXTOPCODE = EXTOPLINE.CODE AND MRNDETAIL.EXTOPORDERLINE = EXTOPLINE.ORDERLINE LEFT OUTER JOIN FULLITEMKEYDECODER ON EXTOPLINE.ENTRYITEMTYPEAFICODE=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.ITEMTYPECODE AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYSUBCODE01=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.SUBCODE01 AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYSUBCODE02=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.SUBCODE02 AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYSUBCODE03=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.SUBCODE03 AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYSUBCODE04=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.SUBCODE04 AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYSUBCODE05=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.SUBCODE05 AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYSUBCODE06=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.SUBCODE06 AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYSUBCODE07=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.SUBCODE07 AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYSUBCODE08=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.SUBCODE08 AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYSUBCODE09=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.SUBCODE09 AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYSUBCODE10=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.SUBCODE10 AND EXTOPLINE.ENTRYITEMTYPEAFICOMPANYCODE=FULLITEMKEYDECODER.COMPANYCODE WHERE MRNHEADER.PURCHASEORDERCODE IS NULL AND ADDRESS.RN = 1 OR ADDRESS.RN IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT MRNHEADER.COMPANYCODE AS COMPANYCODE, MRNHEADER.DIVISIONCODE AS DIVISIONCODE, MRNHEADER.CREATIONUSER AS CREATIONUSER, ADDRESS.ADDRESSEE AS ADDRESSEE, ADDRESS.ADDRESSEE2 AS ADDRESSEE2, ADDRESS.COUNTRYCODE AS ADDCOUNTRYCODE, ADDRESS.ADDRESSLINE1 AS ADDRESSLINE1, ADDRESS.ADDRESSLINE2 AS ADDRESSLINE2, ADDRESS.ADDRESSLINE3 AS ADDRESSLINE3, ADDRESS.ADDRESSLINE4 AS ADDRESSLINE4, ADDRESS.ADDRESSLINE5 AS ADDRESSLINE5, ADDRESS.POSTALCODE AS POSTALCODE, ADDRESS.TOWN AS TOWN, ADDRESS.DISTRICT AS DISTRICT, ADDRESS.ADDRESSPHONENUMBER AS ADDRESSPHONENUMBER, ADDRESS.EMAILADDRESS AS EMAILADDRESS, MRNHEADER.CODE AS MRNNO, MRNHEADER.MRNDATE AS MRNDATE, MRNHEADER.ORDPRNCUSTOMERSUPPLIERCODE AS SUPPLIERCODE, MRNHEADER.CHALLANNO AS CHALLANNO, MRNHEADER.CHALLANDATE AS CHALLANDATE, MRNHEADER.INVOICENO AS INVOICENO, MRNHEADER.INVOICEDATE AS INVOICEDATE, MRNHEADER.MAINGATEENTRYSRNO AS MAINGATEENTRYSRNO, MRNHEADER.MAINGATEENTRYDATE AS MAINGATEENTRYDATE, MRNHEADER.CURRENCYCODE AS CURRENCYCODE, MRNHEADER.MRNPREFIXCODE AS MRNPREFIXCODE, MRNHEADER.REMARK AS REMARK, MRNHEADER.BASICVALUE AS TOTALBASICVALUE, MRNHEADER.NETVALUE AS GRANDTOTALBASICVALUE, PAYMENTMETHOD.LONGDESCRIPTION AS TERMSOFPAYMENTLD, TERMSOFDELIVERY.LONGDESCRIPTION AS TERMSOFDELIVERYLD, TERMSOFSHIPPING.LONGDESCRIPTION AS TERMSOFSHIPPINGLD, BUSINESSPARTNER.LEGALNAME1 AS CONSIGNEELEGALNAME1, BUSINESSPARTNER.ADDRESSLINE1 AS CADDRESSLINE1, BUSINESSPARTNER.ADDRESSLINE2 AS CADDRESSLINE2, BUSINESSPARTNER.ADDRESSLINE3 AS CADDRESSLINE3, BUSINESSPARTNER.ADDRESSLINE4 AS CADDRESSLINE4, BUSINESSPARTNER.ADDRESSLINE5 AS CADDRESSLINE5, BUSINESSPARTNER.POSTALCODE AS CPOSTALCODE, BUSINESSPARTNER.TOWN AS CTOWN, BUSINESSPARTNER.DISTRICT AS CDISTRICT, BUSINESSPARTNER.ADDRESSPHONENUMBER AS CADDRESSPHONENUMBER, BUSINESSPARTNER.COUNTRYCODE AS COUNTRYCODE, BUSINESSPARTNER.ABSUNIQUEID AS BUNIQUEID, ADDRESSGST.GSTINNUMBER AS GSTINNUMBER, MRNDETAIL.ABSUNIQUEID AS DETAILABSUNIQUEID, MRNDETAIL.LINEID AS LINEID, MRNDETAIL.ORDERLINE AS ORDERLINE, MRNDETAIL.ORDERSUBLINE AS ORDERSUBLINE, MRNDETAIL.PRIMARYQTY AS PRIMARYQTY, MRNDETAIL.BASEPRIMARYQTY AS BASEPRIMARYQTY, MRNDETAIL.PRIMARYUMCODE AS PRIMARYUMCODE, MRNDETAIL.UNITPRICE AS UNITPRICE, MRNDETAIL.BASICVALUE AS BASICVALUE, MRNDETAIL.SUBCODE01 AS SUBCODE01, MRNDETAIL.SUBCODE02 AS SUBCODE02, MRNDETAIL.SUBCODE03 AS SUBCODE03, MRNDETAIL.SUBCODE04 AS SUBCODE04, MRNDETAIL.SUBCODE05 AS SUBCODE05, MRNDETAIL.SUBCODE06 AS SUBCODE06, MRNDETAIL.SUBCODE07 AS SUBCODE07, MRNDETAIL.SUBCODE08 AS SUBCODE08, MRNDETAIL.SUBCODE09 AS SUBCODE09,MRNDETAIL.SUBCODE10 AS SUBCODE10, MRNDETAIL.GROSSVALUE AS GROSSVALUE, MRNDETAIL.LOGICALWAREHOUSECODE AS WAREHOUSE, MRNDETAIL.RECEIVEDQUANTITY AS RECEIVEDQUANTITY, MRNDETAIL.TARIFFCODE AS TARIFFCODE, MRNDETAIL.TRANSACTIONNUMBER AS TRANSACTIONNUMBER, MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE AS MRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE, MRNDETAIL.TAXTEMPLATETEMPLATETYPE AS TAXTEMPLATETEMPLATETYPE, MRNDETAIL.TAXTEMPLATECODE AS TAXTEMPLATECODE, MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCODE AS MRNHEADERCODE,MRNDETAIL.PURCHASEORDERCODE AS PURCHASEORDERCODE, PURCHASEORDER.CODE AS ORDERNO, PURCHASEORDERLINE.ITEMTYPEAFICODE AS ITEMTYPECODE, PURCHASEORDERLINE.ITEMDESCRIPTION AS ITEMDESCRIPTION, PURCHASEORDERLINE.PROJECTCODE AS PROJECTCODE, PURCHASEORDER.ORDERDATE AS ORDERDATE, ITEMTYPE.LONGDESCRIPTION AS ITEMTYPELD, ITEMTYPE.ITEMNATURE AS ITEMNATURE, STOCKTYPE.LONGDESCRIPTION AS STLONGDESCRIPTION, NVL((SELECT SUM(RECEIVEDQUANTITY) FROM MRNREJECTIONDETAIL REJ WHERE MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE = REJ.MDMRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE AND MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERDIVISIONCODE = REJ.MDMRNHEADERDIVISIONCODE AND MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERMRNPREFIXCODE = REJ.MDMRNHEADERMRNPREFIXCODE AND MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCODE = REJ.MDMRNHEADERCODE AND MRNDETAIL.LINEID = REJ.MDLINEID),0) REJECTEDQUANTITY, 'NORMAL' MRNTYPE, ' ' AS ENTRYITEMTYPEAFICODE, ' ' AS ENTRYSUBCODE01, ' ' AS ENTRYSUBCODE02, ' ' AS ENTRYSUBCODE03, ' ' AS ENTRYSUBCODE04, ' ' AS ENTRYSUBCODE05, ' ' AS ENTRYSUBCODE06, ' ' AS ENTRYSUBCODE07, ' ' AS ENTRYSUBCODE08, ' ' AS ENTRYSUBCODE09, ' ' AS ENTRYSUBCODE10, ' ' AS ENTRYITEMDESCRIPTION FROM MRNHEADER LEFT OUTER JOIN PAYMENTMETHOD ON MRNHEADER.TERMSOFPAYMENTCOMPANYCODE = PAYMENTMETHOD.COMPANYCODE AND MRNHEADER.TERMSOFPAYMENTCODE = PAYMENTMETHOD.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN DIVISION ON MRNHEADER.COMPANYCODE = DIVISION.COMPANYCODE AND MRNHEADER.DIVISIONCODE = DIVISION.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT A.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.UNIQUEID ORDER BY A.ABSUNIQUEID) AS RN FROM ADDRESS A ) AS ADDRESS ON DIVISION.ABSUNIQUEID = ADDRESS.UNIQUEID LEFT OUTER JOIN TERMSOFDELIVERY ON MRNHEADER.TERMSOFDELIVERYCOMPANYCODE = TERMSOFDELIVERY.COMPANYCODE AND MRNHEADER.TERMSOFDELIVERYCODE = TERMSOFDELIVERY.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TERMSOFSHIPPING ON MRNHEADER.TERMSOFSHIPPINGCOMPANYCODE = TERMSOFSHIPPING.COMPANYCODE AND MRNHEADER.TERMSOFSHIPPINGCODE = TERMSOFSHIPPING.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERPARTNER ON MRNHEADER.COMPANYCODE = ORDERPARTNER.CUSTOMERSUPPLIERCOMPANYCODE AND MRNHEADER.ORDPRNCUSTOMERSUPPLIERTYPE = ORDERPARTNER.CUSTOMERSUPPLIERTYPE AND MRNHEADER.ORDPRNCUSTOMERSUPPLIERCODE = ORDERPARTNER.CUSTOMERSUPPLIERCODE LEFT OUTER JOIN BUSINESSPARTNER ON ORDERPARTNER.ORDERBUSINESSPARTNERNUMBERID = BUSINESSPARTNER.NUMBERID LEFT OUTER JOIN ADDRESSGST ON BUSINESSPARTNER.ABSUNIQUEID = ADDRESSGST.UNIQUEID LEFT OUTER JOIN PURCHASEORDER ON MRNHEADER.COMPANYCODE = PURCHASEORDER.COMPANYCODE AND MRNHEADER.PURCHASEORDERCOUNTERCODE = PURCHASEORDER.COUNTERCODE AND MRNHEADER.PURCHASEORDERCODE = PURCHASEORDER.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN MRNDETAIL ON MRNHEADER.COMPANYCODE = MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE AND MRNHEADER.DIVISIONCODE = MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERDIVISIONCODE AND MRNHEADER.MRNPREFIXCODE=MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERMRNPREFIXCODE AND MRNHEADER.CODE = MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PURCHASEORDERLINE ON MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE = PURCHASEORDERLINE.PURCHASEORDERCOMPANYCODE AND MRNDETAIL.PURCHASEORDERCOUNTERCODE = PURCHASEORDERLINE.PURCHASEORDERCOUNTERCODE AND MRNDETAIL.PURCHASEORDERCODE = PURCHASEORDERLINE.PURCHASEORDERCODE AND MRNDETAIL.ORDERLINE = PURCHASEORDERLINE.ORDERLINE AND MRNDETAIL.ORDERSUBLINE = PURCHASEORDERLINE.ORDERSUBLINE LEFT OUTER JOIN ITEMTYPE ON MRNDETAIL.ITEMTYPEAFICOMPANYCODE = ITEMTYPE.COMPANYCODE AND MRNDETAIL.ITEMTYPEAFICODE = ITEMTYPE.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN STOCKTRANSACTION ON MRNDETAIL.MRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE = STOCKTRANSACTION.COMPANYCODE AND MRNDETAIL.TRANSACTIONNUMBER = STOCKTRANSACTION.TRANSACTIONNUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN STOCKTRANSACTIONTEMPLATE ON STOCKTRANSACTION.TEMPLATECOMPANYCODE = STOCKTRANSACTIONTEMPLATE.COMPANYCODE AND STOCKTRANSACTION.TEMPLATECODE = STOCKTRANSACTIONTEMPLATE.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN STOCKTYPE ON STOCKTRANSACTIONTEMPLATE.STOCKTYPECODE = STOCKTYPE.CODE WHERE MRNHEADER.PURCHASEORDERCODE IS NOT NULL AND ADDRESS.RN = 1 OR ADDRESS.RN IS NULL)

NETFINTRANSACTIONHEADER NH JOIN NETFINTRANSACTIONDETAIL ND ON ND.NETFINTRNHEADERCOMPANYCODE = NH.COMPANYCODE AND ND.NETFINTRANSACTIONHEADERCODE = NH.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN EVENTMASTER EM ON EM.CODE =
